name: Suginami (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Suginami ward emblem in white: a stylised device of crossed lines, like a cedar branch.
history: Municipal flag of Suginami, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 December 1980; the emblem dates from 1 October 1952.

features.role: Suginami ward emblem — a stylised device of crossed lines, like a cedar branch
